snippet.title: PSYCHO DEAD | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018390/PSYCHO_DEAD/?curator_clanid=4777282

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015857



---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
